fields.FIR_Description: The reported incident took place on 2026-05-17 (morning, 09:35): The complainant paid Rs. 15,000 for an item advertised on a social media page, but the item never arrived and the seller stopped responding. Contact details given by the complainant, Senthil Raman, include the number 9000000308. The complaint mentions Senthil Natarajan, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000262, in connection with the events. Transactions from the account SYN-ACC-100049, held by the complainant, were referred to in the complaint. The complaint refers to Mathan Raman, an intermediary, reachable on 9000000187. The complainant mentioned social media screenshots, mobile phone records and digital documents. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00383, as the mobile number 9000000262 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Evidence_Mentioned: Social media screenshot; Mobile phone record; Digital document
fields.Modus_Operandi: Victim reportedly paid in advance and was blocked by the seller.
fields.Keywords: online shopping fraud, fake seller, phone records, morning, associate, suspect, screenshot, residential colony
